description: This Swift source file defines a class 'CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler' which handles JavaScript messages in a WebKit-based iOS/macOS application. It processes in-app canvas actions, verifies URLs, extracts action data, and communicates with a gateway service to send UI actions, with debugging and network checks included.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionMessageHandler
classes.description: A message handler for processing UI actions from web content, facilitating communication between JavaScript in WebView and native code, especially for OpenClaw's in-app canvas.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to a local network resource, considering schemes and IP ranges.

methods.name: userContentController:didReceive
methods.description: Handles incoming JavaScript messages, parses message bodies, extracts action info, and sends agent messages accordingly.

methods.name: parseIPv4
methods.description: Parses a host string into IPv4 address components.

methods.name: isLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if an IPv4 address is within local network ranges.
